## Astraeus 2.8.0

### New
- **Edge glow.** A new visualizer for fullscreen: light round the edges of the screen in the cover's two colors. It swells where the music pushes it and flows along the edge, thrown on by each beat, so a fast song races and a slow one drifts. Turn it on in Edit fullscreen, under Scene. Visualizer strength sets how hard the music drives it.
- **Mix the visualizers.** Glow, Waveform and Edge glow are now three switches in Edit fullscreen, under Scene, and any of them can be on together.
- **Pick the Media page's visualizer.** The Media page shows one at a time: the soft glow, the waveform, or the edge glow round its card. Pick it in Edit fullscreen, under Scene, next to Media tab. The Waveform switch in Settings, under Media, still works too.
- **Lyric glow for vinyl.** Vinyl's sung line can glow in the album's color, the way the full lyrics do. It's off by default: turn it on in Edit fullscreen, under Scene.
- **A theme change pours in.** A new look now pours in from the panel's own edge like a sheet of liquid glass, leading where your pointer was and settling as it lands.

### Fixed
- An update no longer restarts Astraeus while a game or a video is fullscreen. It waits until you're done.
- Menus, tooltips and tags across the panel now share one look and fade in the same way.
- The problem report now says which player is playing and what came of its lyrics, so lyrics problems are easier to track down. It never includes the song itself.

> [!NOTE]
> The executable is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may show an "unknown publisher" warning the first time. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
